findings.text: The dossier provides host helpers that manage virtualized APIC behavior including programming the access page address refreshing execution controls for register virtualization and delivery and loading exit maps for end of interrupt handling.
The dossier provides helpers that establish a task state area for real mode guests and that record an identity mapped address for use with extended page tables.
The dossier provides helpers that publish a virtual CPU time stamp counter offset and scaling ratio into virtual machine control state.
The dossier provides helpers that arm or cancel a host side timer deadline derived from a guest deadline and that adjust feature control validity according to machine check capability.
The dossier provides a virtual machine ioctl dispatcher for trust domain guests that serves capability query initialization and finalization requests.

Dispatch points for APIC virtualization refresh end of interrupt map loading and machine check setup check for trust domain virtual CPUs first. Trust domain cases validate active state or return quietly while other guests delegate to the VMX implementation.

Dispatch points for task state setup identity map setup and supervisor mode execution prevention query give benign defaults for trust domain guests and otherwise delegate to VMX helpers that consult a global mode flag or record state.

Dispatch points for level two time stamp counter offset and multiplier query or update suppress observable effects for trust domain virtual CPUs by yielding zero or returning quietly and otherwise delegate to VMX helpers.
Dispatch points for host timer arming and cancellation treat the preemption timer as unavailable for trust domain virtual CPUs and otherwise delegate to VMX helpers.
The memory encryption ioctl dispatch point rejects guests that are not trust domains and forwards trust domain guests to the trust domain virtual machine handler.

The trust domain ioctl handler is an entry point that fetches a command validates it handles capability query without state guarding and handles initialization and finalization under a state guard before copying the command back.

Access page programming proceeds only when virtualized APIC accesses are enabled in primary control state and a usable private slot exists. The implementation looks up an internal slot identifier and honors an invalid marker rather than trusting user supplied slots.

The access page path samples the invalidation sequence before faulting with write intent then under read protection either defers work through a reload request on concurrent invalidation or publishes the hardware address. The backing page is released rather than pinned and no extra flush is done at that point.

APIC virtualization refresh updates pin based controls and makes register virtualization plus virtual interrupt delivery follow the active state. An optional inter processor interrupt virtualization control follows the same state when globally enabled and the extended APIC bitmap is updated.
End of interrupt exit map loading has effect only when APIC virtualization is active and then publishes four bitmap words into control state.

Task state setup is skipped when unrestricted guest execution is enabled. Otherwise a small multi page private region is established under lock the address is remembered and the area is cleared with an IO permission base value plus an end terminator installed.

Host timer arming derives a non negative guest delta from deadline and current guest time subtracts a lapic advance when possible converts through time stamp scaling when the ratio differs from default and rejects values that exceed the preemption timer limit. The stored host deadline adds the resulting delta to current host time.

The wide shift divide helper treats its input as a high plus low pair after shifting and reports overflow when the high part meets or exceeds the divisor. Otherwise it divides the combined value and returns the quotient through an out parameter.
Machine check setup makes local machine check exception enablement in the valid feature control bits track whether the guest capability advertises local machine check support.

Capability query requires zero flags and a user buffer large enough for all module configured CPUID entries. It builds a temporary capabilities object with supported attributes supported extended features entry count event notify info and per index entries then copies it to the caller.

Trust domain CPUID template entries derive function index and register values from module configuration tables with a sentinel subleaf normalized. One extended leaf has its guest physical width field forced for reporting and two feature families are cleared when present.

Trust domain initialization requires uninitialized state zero command flags a bounded entry count an all zero reserved area and stable non padded count. It rejects creation after virtual CPUs exist and rejects attributes or extended features outside supported masks.

Parameter setup fills maximum virtual CPU count attributes and extended features with fixed bits set plus configuration flags and converted time stamp frequency. It then derives extended page table controls and CPUID values and copies measurement identifiers with a size equality checked copy.

Extended page table controls require the physical width leaf and accept only two widths with five level paging required for the larger width. The controls select write back memory type plus the matching paging level and set a maximum address width flag for the larger width.

CPUID parameterization walks the module configured count builds a template per position skips user missing entries rejects unsupported feature combinations copies supplied register values clears the physical width field for the extended leaf and requires every user entry to have been consumed.

Low level trust domain creation allocates a key identifier charges a misc counter allocates a root page and a module sized set of control pages plus derives a related extended page count. It requires an online CPU in every present package creates under a global lock handles entropy and module errors and programs each package key once.
Access page programming holds a virtual CPU control guard while checking enablement and holds read protection while deciding between deferred reload and address publication.
APIC virtualization refresh holds a virtual CPU control guard across pin secondary and optional tertiary control updates plus bitmap maintenance.
Task state address establishment serializes private region creation with the virtual machine slot lock.
Trust domain ioctl handling guards initialization and finalization with a virtual machine state guard while capability query runs without that guard.
Trust domain creation holds a CPU read lock across package presence validation and per package key programming and holds a global mutex around the create operation that can report operand busy.

Observed trust domain parameters include maximum virtual CPUs attributes extended features configuration flags time stamp frequency extended page table controls an indexed CPUID value array aligned with module configuration and measurement identifier fields.

Observed command exchange carries an identifier flags a data pointer and a hardware error field. Observed capabilities carry supported attributes supported extended features a CPUID count with entries and event notification info. Initialization input carries attributes extended features measurements and CPUID entries.

Observed virtual machine state includes trust domain lifecycle state key identifier misc group trust domain pages cached time stamp offset and multiplier attributes extended features and direct mapping bits plus VMX specific task state and identity addresses. Observed virtual CPU state includes APIC timer advance host deadline and feature control validity.

Trust domain lifecycle starts uninitialized and moves to initialized only after successful parameter setup and low level creation. Capability query is available without that transition while initialization and finalization pass through guarded dispatch.
Access page handling has two outcomes after faulting. Concurrent invalidation moves work to a deferred reload request while a stable sequence publishes the hardware address immediately.
Host deadline state is armed to host time plus adjusted delta with an expired indication when the delta is zero and later cancelled to a sentinel all set value.

Many virtualization technology operations have dual behavior. Trust domain guests observe fixed defaults or silent no operation while other guests follow the normal VMX transition that updates controls timers maps or addresses.

Access page setup returns quietly for missing or invalid slots and error faults. A missing refcounted backing page triggers a one time warning path and concurrent invalidation is handled by deferral rather than immediate publication.
Task state initialization propagates user copy faults and private region establishment errors. Unrestricted guest mode avoids those paths entirely.
Timer arming fails with a range indication on scaling overflow or when the adjusted delta exceeds the preemption timer capacity. Trust domain timer arming fails as invalid argument.

Trust domain management rejects zero flag violations size mismatches nonzero reserved or padding unstable counts busy creation unsupported attributes features or CPUID entries missing width leaf invalid widths missing five level support and module or package failures with distinct invalid too big busy no memory IO or retry indications.
User memory interactions can fail during command fetch capability copy initialization copy and final result copy. Temporary allocation failures are reported as no memory.
Time stamp frequency conversion expresses kilohertz in twenty five megahertz units by dividing by twenty five thousand.
The real mode task state area spans three pages. Initialization clears all three then stores a combined base size at the IO permission base offset and a terminator near the end.
Allowed guest physical address widths are forty eight and fifty two with four and five level paging respectively and distinct shared bit selections for direct mapping.
Initialization input size is asserted as two hundred fifty six plus the CPUID portion and low level parameters size is asserted as one thousand twenty four.
Feature filtering uses leaf seven index zero for two feature families and an extended leaf for guest physical width handling.
A sentinel subleaf value in module CPUID configuration is normalized to zero when building template entries.
